title: Make backups org-aware and drive-friendly
context: Keep one org/repo hierarchy locally and online, with encryption and a tested

spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: The org/repo tree is documented for local and online copy.
`private` and the Gitea dump are encrypted.
Linux/OpenCode/SSH config is included or explicitly excluded with a reason.
Online sync preserves the same hierarchy and checksums.
A restore drill recreates the local org/repo layout.
The backup README links the org model and ADR-0005.
The microSD state check still passes.
Add encryption for private archives and the dump.
Write and test the restore drill.
Link the org model and backup ADR.
A restore drill reconstructs the local layout.
No plaintext private archive or dump is uploaded.
